content.text:
I fixed the orders page. The table header was missing its "Total" column heading. The rows had six cells but the header only had five. Because of that, the header row stopped short of the right edge and the whole table sat about 1px off at desktop and phone size.

I added `<th class="num">Total</th>` back in `site/orders.html`. All 28 tests now pass: the 16 functional tests and the 12 visual tests, including both orders screenshots. I didn't commit anything.

STATUS: DONE
